en:
Oh, Shuichi. Good timing.
Do you wanna join me?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Himiko for a while?

Hm, good answer. In that case, you're going to
help me maintain my magical implements.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time with Himiko gathering
materials for her magic tricks—
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko and I grew a little closer today.
